breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflicting time integration instructions. The original prompt incorrectly listed both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' method. The ground truth corrected this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction entirely. The agent, however, attempted to merge the two, stating 'Use forward Euler time integration framework with Strang splitting,' which is incorrect and does not resolve the ambiguity.
